conf.description: F5 BIG-IP LTM request-log / json: thin pass-through, parsing deferred to Elastic (elastic-integration).

conf.comment: f5-bigip-ltm / request-log / json. Parsing is deliberately NOT implemented here: the Elastic integration is the parser downstream (Elastic f5_bigip integration, data stream logs-f5_bigip.log (Agent HTTP endpoint, Telemetry Streaming JSON)). Re-implementing that parsing in Cribl would fight it and yield duplicate or conflicting fields, so this pipeline only identifies the event and tags event.dataset, then passes _raw through unmodified. Direct route (no cross-domain guard hop).
